api_key.description: Merchant-level API key issued by Qubriux

customer_info.description: Customer profile data. At least one identifier — mobile, email, or id — must be provided.

id.description: Your system's unique customer identifier. Used to link the Qubriux record to your database.

name.description: Customer's full name. Use this or firstName + lastName, not both.

mobile.description: Mobile number including country code. Used as a primary customer identifier.

email.description: Email address. Used as a secondary identifier and for marketing communications.

dob.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format. Used to trigger birthday rewards.

anniversary_date.description: Anniversary date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Used to trigger anniversary rewards.

nationality.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for the customer's nationality

country_code.description: International dialling code for the customer's mobile number

customerTitle.description: Honorific title (e.g. Mr, Mrs, Dr, Ms)

referralCode.description: Referral code assigned to this customer for sharing. Generated by Qubriux or your system.

referredBy.description: Referral code of the customer who referred this customer. Triggers referral rewards if configured.

isSMSMarketingConsentGiven.description: Customer has consented to receive SMS marketing messages

isEmailMarketingConsentGiven.description: Customer has consented to receive email marketing messages

isLoyaltyConsentGiven.description: Customer has consented to participate in the loyalty programme. Customers without consent may not earn or redeem points depending on merchant configuration.

isWalletRequired.description: Whether a digital wallet should be provisioned on registration. Defaults to false.

isProfileComplete.description: Whether the customer profile is considered complete. Used to drive profile completion prompts in the app.

createdAt.description: Customer registration timestamp in your system (ISO 8601)

line_1.description: Primary address line (street number and name)

customer_info.title: CustomerInfo

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the customer registered in your system. Server time is used if omitted.

customer_source.description: Channel or system where the customer registered. Used for segmentation and attribution reporting.
